# Vincent Ndegwa

> Vincent Ndegwa is a software and AI engineer with six years of experience building scalable software applications and AI products: full-stack platforms, payment systems, RAG pipelines and LLM features. He leads engineering on a multi-tenant ERP and POS platform at Paysoko Systems and holds an MSc in Artificial Intelligence from the Open University of Kenya.
